# Tahap 3 — Kirim data: data RDP ke Telegram + banner koneksi. Link XyDesk hanya tampil selama sesi berjalan.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. "$PSScriptRoot/../lib/common.ps1"
. "$PSScriptRoot/../lib/ui.ps1"
$script:XyTag = 'KzRDP:send'
Write-Phase '3/6' 'Kirim data'

$sent = Invoke-Part 'Kirim data RDP ke Telegram' 'session/kzrdp-token.ps1' '-Action ready' -TimeoutMin 5 -Soft
$st = Read-Status
if (-not $st) { throw 'Status sesi belum tersedia.' }
$endpoint = if ($env:KZRDP_TUNNEL_HOST) { "$($env:KZRDP_TUNNEL_HOST):$($env:KZRDP_TUNNEL_PORT)" }
  elseif ($st.akses.mode -eq 'portmap') { "$($st.akses.portmap.host):$($st.akses.portmap.port)" }
  else { "$($st.akses.tailscale.ip):3389" }
# Alamat adalah kunci akses: di repository publik tidak ditulis ke log; hanya dikirim ke Telegram pemilik token.
$showHost = ($env:REPO_PRIVATE -eq 'true')
$lines = @(
  "Host      : $(if ($showHost) { $endpoint } else { 'dikirim ke DM Telegram (tidak ditulis di log publik)' })",
  "Username  : $env:RDP_USER",
  "Password  : $(if ($sent) { 'dikirim ke DM Telegram' } else { 'lihat di dashboard / password managermu' }) (tidak ditulis di log)",
  "Berakhir  : $($st.expires_at) UTC"
)
Write-Host ''
Write-Banner 'KONEKSI SIAP' $lines '1;32'
Write-Host ((C '1;35' '  Unduh XyDesk Remote : ') + (C '4;96' "$env:XYDESK_URL") + (C '90' '  (hanya tersedia selama sesi berjalan)'))
Write-Host (C '90' '  Jika desktop hitam tetapi pointer terlihat: Ctrl+Alt+End > Task Manager > Run new task > explorer.exe')
Write-Host ''

if ($env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY) {
  $hostShown = if ($showHost) { "``$endpoint``" } else { 'dikirim ke Telegram' }
  @(
    '## 🟢 Koneksi siap', '',
    '| | |', '| --- | --- |',
    "| Host | $hostShown |", "| Username | ``$env:RDP_USER`` |",
    "| Password | $(if ($sent) { 'dikirim ke Telegram' } else { 'tidak dikirim — cek dashboard' }) |",
    "| Berakhir (UTC) | $($st.expires_at) |", '',
    '> Link unduh XyDesk dan data lengkap hanya dikirim ke Telegram dan tampil di log selama sesi berjalan.', ''
  ) -join "`n" | Out-File -Append -Encoding utf8 $env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
}
Write-Summary 'Kirim data'

1dc998d07f8e85ad.data:
# Tahap 1 (lanjutan) — dijalankan setelah paket diunduh: durasi, password, info lingkungan.
# Token, email, dan username GitHub sudah diverifikasi server sebelum paket ini bisa diunduh.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. "$PSScriptRoot/../lib/common.ps1"
. "$PSScriptRoot/../lib/ui.ps1"
$script:XyTag = 'KzRDP:verify'
Write-Phase '1/6' 'Verifikasi'

# Durasi: angka menit 10–360 (maks 6 jam, termasuk waktu persiapan).
$raw = "$env:DUR".Trim()
if ($raw -notmatch '^\d{1,3}$' -or [int]$raw -lt 10 -or [int]$raw -gt 360) {
  Write-Host "::error title=Durasi tidak valid::Isi menit antara 10 dan 360 (nilai sekarang: '$raw')."
  exit 1
}
$dur = [int]$raw
$used = [Math]::Min($dur, 355)   # 5 menit cadangan untuk simpan sesi + finalisasi (batas job GitHub 360 menit)


# Password RDP: pakai secret RDP_PASSWORD bila ada, jika kosong dibuat acak (dikirim ke Telegram, tidak ke log).
$pw = "$env:RDP_PASSWORD_SECRET"
$generated = $false
if ($pw.Length -lt 8) {
  $chars = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789'
  $bytes = [byte[]]::new(18); [Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Fill($bytes)
  $pw = 'Kz#' + (($bytes | ForEach-Object { $chars[$_ % $chars.Length] }) -join '') + '9a'
  $generated = $true
}
Write-Host "::add-mask::$pw"
Add-Content -Path $env:GITHUB_ENV -Value "RDP_PASSWORD=$pw"

$os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
$disks = Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk | Where-Object { $_.Size } | ForEach-Object { '{0} {1:N0} GB total / {2:N0} GB bebas' -f $_.DeviceID, ($_.Size / 1GB), ($_.FreeSpace / 1GB) }
$opts = @()
foreach ($o in @(@('XYDESK', 'XyDesk'), @('MICROPHONE', 'Mikrofon'), @('SAMP', 'Dependensi legacy'), @('STORAGE_BOOST', 'Storage boost'), @('WIN10', 'Tampilan Win10'), @('EXTRAS', 'Ekstra'), @('DEVTOOLS', 'Tools dev'))) {
  if ((Get-Item "env:$($o[0])" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Value -eq 'ya') { $opts += $o[1] }
}
if ($env:GRAFIS -eq 'software') { $opts += 'Grafis Mesa' }
$lines = @(
  "Windows   : $($os.Caption) (build $($os.Version))",
  "Runner    : $env:KZRDP_RUNNER",
  ("Durasi    : $dur menit" + $(if ($used -lt $dur) { " (dipakai $used; 5 menit cadangan simpan sesi)" } else { '' })),
  "Akses     : $env:AKSES",
  "Pengguna  : $env:RDP_USER",
  "Password  : $(if ($generated) { 'dibuat acak (dikirim ke Telegram)' } else { 'dari secret RDP_PASSWORD' })",
  "Opsi      : $(if ($opts.Count) { $opts -join ', ' } else { '-' })"
) + @($disks | ForEach-Object { "Disk      : $_" })
Write-Banner 'KzRDP — sesi dimulai' $lines '1;35'

if ($env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY) {
  @(
    '## 🖥️ KzRDP — sesi RDP', '',
    '| Pengaturan | Nilai |', '| --- | --- |',
    "| Windows | $($os.Caption) |", "| Runner | ``$env:KZRDP_RUNNER`` |",
    "| Durasi | $dur menit |", "| Akses | $env:AKSES |", "| Pengguna RDP | ``$env:RDP_USER`` |",
    "| Opsi aktif | $(if ($opts.Count) { $opts -join ', ' } else { '-' }) |", ''
  ) -join "`n" | Out-File -Append -Encoding utf8 $env:GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
}
Write-Summary 'Verifikasi'

59872508bdeb7203.data:
# ============================================================================
#  persist-state.ps1 — simpan folder pengguna ke out/kzrdp-state.zip untuk
#  di-upload sebagai artifact `kzrdp-state` (dipulihkan restore-state.ps1
#  pada sesi berikutnya). Folder: Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures,
#  Music, Videos. Sistem/software tidak disimpan (ephemeral runner).
#
#  Env: RDP_USER, GITHUB_WORKSPACE, RUNNER_TEMP.
# ============================================================================
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
function Log([string]$m) { Write-Host "[KzRDP:persist] $m" }

$profile = "C:\Users\$env:RDP_USER"
if (-not (Test-Path $profile)) { $profile = $env:USERPROFILE }
Log "profil sumber: $profile"

$dirs = @('Desktop','Documents','Downloads','Pictures','Music','Videos')
$staging = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'kzrdp-persist'
if (Test-Path $staging) { Remove-Item $staging -Recurse -Force }

$total = 0L
foreach ($d in $dirs) {
  $src = Join-Path $profile $d
  if (-not (Test-Path $src)) { continue }
  $size = (Get-ChildItem $src -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum
  if (-not $size -or $size -lt 1) { continue }
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $staging $d) -Force | Out-Null
  Copy-Item -Path (Join-Path $src '*') -Destination (Join-Path $staging $d) -Recurse -Force
  $total += $size
  Log "  $d : $([math]::Round($size/1MB,1)) MB"
}

if ($total -lt 1) { Log 'tidak ada data pengguna untuk disimpan'; exit 0 }
if ($total -gt 2GB) { Log "PERINGATAN: total $([math]::Round($total/1GB,2)) GB di atas 2 GB — upload bisa lambat/gagal." }

$out = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE 'out\kzrdp-state.zip'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path $out -Parent) -Force | Out-Null
Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $staging '*') -DestinationPath $out -Force
Log "simpanan sesi: $([math]::Round($total/1MB,1)) MB → $out"

# Kazama Tech — optional CPU-renderer toolkit, NOT a physical GPU or FPS upgrade.
# Keep Mesa files isolated: never overwrite Windows DLLs or force software rendering globally.
$XyTag = 'KzRDP:grafis'
. "$PSScriptRoot/../lib/common.ps1"
$root = 'C:\KzRDP\grafis'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root | Out-Null
$adapters = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }) -join ' | '
try {
  $asset = Get-GhAssetUrl 'pal1000/mesa-dist-win' 'mesa3d-.*-release-msvc\.7z$'
  if (-not $asset) { throw 'Mesa release asset unavailable' }
  $archive = Join-Path $root $asset.name
  if (-not (Get-File $asset.url $archive 300)) { throw 'Mesa download failed' }
  $seven = Get-Command 7z.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  $sevenPath = if ($seven) { $seven.Source } else { "$env:ProgramFiles\7-Zip\7z.exe" }
  if (-not (Test-Path $sevenPath)) { throw '7-Zip unavailable' }
  $destination = Join-Path $root ('mesa-' + ($asset.tag -replace '[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]', '_'))
  & $sevenPath x $archive "-o$destination" -y 2>&1 | Out-Null
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Mesa extraction failed' }
  $dlls = @(Get-ChildItem $destination -Recurse -Filter opengl32.dll -File -ErrorAction Stop)
  if (-not $dlls.Count) { throw 'Mesa OpenGL files missing from extracted release' }
  @"
Optional Mesa CPU renderer toolkit: $destination
Windows graphics drivers and DLLs were not changed.
Keep each architecture and its dependencies together; x86 applications need x86 libraries.
No global environment override is installed. Do not copy DLLs into System32/SysWOW64.
Use the package's upstream per-application deployment instructions only for an application that needs Mesa.
Mesa OpenGL/Vulkan support is not a Direct3D 9 fix for GTA SA.
WARP is provided by Windows for supported Direct3D uses; it does not create a hardware GPU.
CPU rendering may be slower, and game compatibility/performance has NOT been validated.
This script does not restore DLLs modified by older scripts on existing sessions.
"@ | Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'README.txt') -Encoding utf8
  Log "Mesa toolkit staged at $destination; NOT activated globally. No FPS gain claimed."
  Update-Status @{ grafis = @{ mode='toolkit_only'; mesa=$asset.tag; adapters=$adapters; note='Optional isolated CPU renderer files; not activated or benchmarked.' } } | Out-Null
} catch {
  Log "Graphics toolkit unavailable: $($_.Exception.Message)"
  Update-Status @{ grafis = @{ mode='gagal'; adapters=$adapters; note='Toolkit staging failed; native Windows graphics unchanged.' } } | Out-Null
}

# KzRDP wallpaper and real RDP audio-input redirection. Credit: Kazama Tech.
$XyTag='KzRDP:media'
. "$PSScriptRoot/../lib/common.ps1"
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root='C:\ProgramData\KzRDP'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '../session/diagnose-desktop.ps1') (Join-Path $root 'Diagnose-Desktop.ps1') -Force
$mic=$env:MICROPHONE -ne 'tidak'
$wall=$true
$policy='Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services'
Set-Reg $policy 'fDisableAudio' 0 'DWord' | Out-Null
Set-Reg $policy 'fDisableAudioCapture' ([int](-not $mic)) 'DWord' | Out-Null
Set-Reg $policy 'fNoRemoteDesktopWallpaper' ([int](-not $wall)) 'DWord' | Out-Null
foreach ($service in @('AudioEndpointBuilder','Audiosrv')) {
  try { Set-Service $service -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction Stop; Start-Service $service -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Log "Layanan $service belum aktif" }
}
if ($mic) { Set-Reg 'Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\CapabilityAccessManager\ConsentStore\microphone' 'Value' 'Allow' 'String' | Out-Null }
$wallStatus='disabled'
if ($wall) {
  $target=Join-Path $root 'wallpaper.jpg'
  Copy-Item (Join-Path (Get-Workspace) 'assets\wallpaper.jpg') $target -Force
  $apply=Join-Path $root 'Apply-Desktop.ps1'
  $script=@'
$root='C:\ProgramData\KzRDP'
$image=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'wallpaper-path.txt') -Raw
$image=$image.Trim()
if (-not (Test-Path $image)) { exit 1 }
$desk='HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop'
Set-ItemProperty $desk -Name Wallpaper -Value $image
Set-ItemProperty $desk -Name WallpaperStyle -Value '10'
Set-ItemProperty $desk -Name TileWallpaper -Value '0'

Add-Type -TypeDefinition 'using System.Runtime.InteropServices; public class KzRDPDesktop { [DllImport("user32.dll",CharSet=CharSet.Unicode,SetLastError=true)] public static extern bool SystemParametersInfo(int a,int b,string c,int d); }'
[KzRDPDesktop]::SystemParametersInfo(20,0,$image,3) | Out-Null
'@
  $script | Set-Content $apply -Encoding UTF8
  $target | Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'wallpaper-path.txt') -Encoding UTF8
  Set-RegBoth 'Control Panel\Desktop' 'Wallpaper' $target 'String' | Out-Null
  Set-RegBoth 'Control Panel\Desktop' 'WallpaperStyle' '10' 'String' | Out-Null
  Set-RegBoth 'Control Panel\Desktop' 'TileWallpaper' '0' 'String' | Out-Null
  $active='Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\{86C45F69-A012-4D8E-BC70-4A3B4A597652}'
  Set-Reg $active 'Version' '3,0,0,0' 'String' | Out-Null
  Set-Reg $active 'StubPath' "powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$apply`"" 'String' | Out-Null
  Set-RegBoth 'Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' 'KzRDPWallpaper' "powershell.exe -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$apply`"" 'String' | Out-Null
  Close-DefaultHive
  if ((Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path $policy -Name 'fNoRemoteDesktopWallpaper') -ne 0) { throw 'Kebijakan Windows masih memblokir wallpaper Remote Desktop' }
  $wallStatus='kzrdp_configured_for_user_logon'
}
Update-Status @{media=@{wallpaper=$wallStatus;microphone=$(if ($mic) {'rdp_capture_enabled'} else {'disabled'});audio_output='rdp_playback_enabled';verification='Login ulang, aktifkan mic di XyDesk dan izinkan Android. Uji Windows Settings > Sound > Input; kebijakan aktif bukan bukti capture end-to-end.'}} | Out-Null
Log 'Wallpaper profil dan audio capture disiapkan; pengujian suara tetap memerlukan klien tersambung.'

# ============================================================================
#  setup-win10.ps1 — "Windows 10 look" untuk runner windows-2022
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Catatan jujur: runner GitHub TIDAK punya image Windows 10 desktop. Yang
#  dipakai adalah Windows Server 2022 yang secara UI/kernel = Windows 10 21H2
#  (build 20348) — jadi tampilannya sudah Windows 10. Script ini menambahkan
#  yang khas "Windows 10" dan mematikan yang khas "Server":
#
#    1) Server Manager tidak muncul saat login, IE Enhanced Security mati
#    2) Shutdown Event Tracker mati (tidak tanya "alasan shutdown")
#    3) Personalisasi: transparansi, warna aksen di taskbar, taskbar
#       "jangan gabungkan tombol", kotak pencarian, tema gelap taskbar
#    4) Wallpaper + latar login/lock screen bergaya Windows 10
#    5) Ctrl+Alt+Del tidak diwajibkan di layar login (seperti Windows 10)
#    6) Windows Search diaktifkan supaya Start menu bisa mencari
#    7) (opsional) label "Windows 10 Pro" di registry — kosmetik
#
#  Semua langkah BEST-EFFORT: gagal satu tidak mematikan sesi.
#  Konfigurasi: assets/rdp-extras.json -> win10_look / win10_badge /
#  win10_wallpaper (bisa diubah dari dashboard web).
# ============================================================================

$XyTag = 'KzRDP:win10'
. "$PSScriptRoot/../lib/common.ps1"

# ---------- 0. master switch ----------
$skip = $false
if ($env:WIN10) { $e = $env:WIN10.Trim().ToLower(); if (@('tidak', '0', 'false', 'no', 'off', 'skip', 'none') -contains $e) { $skip = $true } }
$cfg = Get-Cfg
if (-not $cfg.win10_look) { $skip = $true }
if ($skip) {
  Log 'tweak Windows 10 dilewati (input WIN10=tidak atau win10_look=false di rdp-extras.json)'
  Update-Status @{ win10 = @{ look = 'skip' } } | Out-Null
  exit 0
}
Log "mulai tweak Windows 10 (badge=$($cfg.win10_badge) wallpaper=$($cfg.win10_wallpaper) dark=$($cfg.dark_theme) ringan=$($cfg.lightweight_mode))"

$os = try { Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem } catch { $null }
Log "  OS terpasang: $($os.Caption) build $($os.Version) — UI-nya sama dengan Windows 10 21H2"

# ---------- 1. buang ciri khas "Server" ----------
Open-DefaultHive | Out-Null

# Server Manager: jangan buka otomatis saat login
Set-RegBoth 'Software\Microsoft\ServerManager' 'DoNotOpenServerManagerAtLogon' 1 'DWord' | Out-Null
# Shutdown Event Tracker: jangan tanya alasan
Set-Reg 'Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Reliability\Shutdown' 'ShutdownReasonOn' 0 'DWord' | Out-Null
# IE Enhanced Security Configuration (2 key: admin + user)
foreach ($guid in @('{A509B1A7-37EF-4b3f-8CFC-4F3A74704073}', '{A509B1A8-37EF-4b3f-8CFC-4F3A74704073}')) {
  Set-Reg "Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\$guid" 'IsInstalled' 0 'DWord' | Out-Null
}
Log '  Server Manager & Shutdown Event Tracker dimatikan, IE ESC dimatikan'

# ---------- 2. layar login ala Windows 10 ----------
# Windows 10 tidak mewajibkan Ctrl+Alt+Del di layar login
Set-Reg 'Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon' 'DisableCAD' 1 'DWord' | Out-Null
# sembunyikan teks versi/edisi di sudut desktop
Set-RegBoth 'Control Panel\Desktop' 'PaintDesktopVersion' 0 'DWord' | Out-Null
# sembunyikan akun Administrator bawaan supaya layar login bersih (job runner
# jalan sebagai runneradmin, jadi tidak terpengaruh)
try { Disable-LocalUser -Name 'Administrator' -ErrorAction Stop; Log '  akun Administrator bawaan dinonaktifkan (layar login bersih)' } catch { Log "  nonaktifkan Administrator dilewati: $($_.Exception.Message)" }

# ---------- 3. personalisasi ala Windows 10 ----------
$themeMode = if ($cfg.dark_theme) { 0 } else { 1 }
Set-RegBoth 'Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize' 'EnableTransparency' $transparencyMode 'DWord' | Out-Null
Set-RegBoth 'Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize' 'ColorPrevalence'   1 'DWord' | Out-Null   # warna aksen di taskbar (khas Win10)
Set-RegBoth 'Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize' 'SystemUsesLightTheme' $themeMode 'DWord' | Out-Null
Set-RegBoth 'Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize' 'AppsUseLightTheme'   $themeMode 'DWord' | Out-Null
# taskbar: jangan gabungkan tombol (default Win10), kotak pencarian, tombol Task View
$adv = 'Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced'
Set-RegBoth $adv 'TaskbarGlomLevel'      2 'DWord' | Out-Null
Set-RegBoth $adv 'TaskbarSmallIcons'     0 'DWord' | Out-Null
Set-RegBoth $adv 'SearchboxTaskbarMode'  2 'DWord' | Out-Null
Set-RegBoth $adv 'ShowTaskViewButton'    1 'DWord' | Out-Null
Set-RegBoth $adv 'EnableAutoTray'        0 'DWord' | Out-Null
# warna aksen biru Windows 10 (#0078D7)
$dwm = 'Software\Microsoft\Windows\DWM'

# ---------- 5. wallpaper & latar login ----------
function Get-Win10WallpaperFile {
  $names = @()
  # Pilihan dashboard/current config harus didahulukan; wallpaper-win10.* hanya
  # fallback. Kalau tidak, gambar bawaan lama akan menimpa wallpaper upload.
  if ($cfg.wallpaper_file) { $names += @($cfg.wallpaper_file) }
  if ($cfg.win10_wallpaper) { $names += @('wallpaper-win10.jpg', 'wallpaper-win10.png') }
  $names += @('wallpaper.jpg', 'wallpaper.jpeg', 'wallpaper.png', 'wallpaper.bmp')
  foreach ($n in $names) {
    $p = Join-Path (Get-Workspace) "assets\$n"
    if (Test-Path $p) { return $p }
  }
  if ($env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY -and $cfg.wallpaper_file) {
    $tmp = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'wp-win10.jpg'
    $rawName = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($cfg.wallpaper_file)
    if (Get-File "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$($env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY)/main/assets/$rawName" $tmp 120) { return $tmp }
  }
  return $null
}

# Resize + kompres ke JPEG < 256 KB (batas latar layar login Windows)
function Save-LogonBackground([string]$Src, [string]$Dst, [int]$MaxKB = 240) {
  try {
    Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing -ErrorAction Stop
    $img = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile($Src)
    $w = 1920; $h = [int]($img.Height * (1920.0 / $img.Width)); if ($h -gt 1080) { $h = 1080; $w = [int]($img.Width * (1080.0 / $img.Height)) }
    foreach ($q in @(85, 75, 65, 55)) {
      $bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($w, $h)
      $g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp)
      $g.InterpolationMode = [System.Drawing.Drawing2D.InterpolationMode]::HighQualityBicubic
      $g.DrawImage($img, 0, 0, $w, $h); $g.Dispose()
      $enc = [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageCodecInfo]::GetImageEncoders() | Where-Object { $_.MimeType -eq 'image/jpeg' }
      $ep = New-Object System.Drawing.Imaging.EncoderParameters(1)
      $ep.Param[0] = New-Object System.Drawing.Imaging.EncoderParameter([System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder]::Quality, [int64]$q)
      $bmp.Save($Dst, $enc, $ep)
      $bmp.Dispose()
      $kb = [math]::Round((Get-Item $Dst).Length / 1KB)
      if ($kb -le $MaxKB) { Log "  latar login: ${w}x${h}, ${kb} KB (kualitas $q)"; $img.Dispose(); return $true }
    }
    $img.Dispose()
    Log "  latar login: $([math]::Round((Get-Item $Dst).Length / 1KB)) KB (di atas batas 256 KB, Windows mungkin mengabaikan)"
    return $true
  } catch { Log "  gagal menyiapkan latar login: $($_.Exception.Message)"; return $false }
}

# ---------- 6. (opsional) label "Windows 10 Pro" di registry ----------
$badgeStatus = 'skip'
if ($cfg.win10_badge) {
  try {
    $cv = 'Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion'
    $b1 = Set-Reg $cv 'ProductName'     'Windows 10 Pro' 'String'
    $b2 = Set-Reg $cv 'EditionID'       'Professional'   'String'
    $b3 = Set-Reg $cv 'CompositionEditionID' 'Professional' 'String'
    $b4 = Set-Reg $cv 'DisplayVersion'  '22H2'           'String'
    $badgewins = @($b1, $b2, $b3, $b4 | Where-Object { $_ }).Count
    # ProductType: key ini milik TrustedInstaller -> ambil kepemilikan dulu
    $key = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::LocalMachine.OpenSubKey('SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\ProductOptions', $true)
    if (-not $key) {
      $key = [Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::LocalMachine.OpenSubKey('SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\ProductOptions',
              [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryKeyPermissionCheck]::ReadWriteSubTree, [System.Security.AccessControl.RegistryRights]::TakeOwnership)
      $ident = [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
      $acl = $key.GetAccessControl([System.Security.AccessControl.AccessControlSections]::None)
      $acl.SetOwner($ident.User); $key.SetAccessControl($acl)
      $acl = $key.GetAccessControl()
      $acl.SetAccessRule((New-Object System.Security.AccessControl.RegistryAccessRule($ident.Name, 'FullControl', 'Allow')))
      $key.SetAccessControl($acl)
    }
    $key.SetValue('ProductType', 'WinNT', [Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind]::String)
    $key.Close()
    Log "  label registry: Windows 10 Pro / 22H2 (ProductType=WinNT, $badgewins/4 kunci nama produk berhasil)"
    $badgeStatus = if ($badgewins -ge 3) { 'ok' } else { "sebagian ($badgewins/4)" }
  } catch { Log "  label Windows 10 gagal (tidak kritis): $($_.Exception.Message)"; $badgeStatus = 'gagal' }
} else {
  Log '  label Windows 10 dimatikan (win10_badge=false) — sistem tetap menampilkan nama Windows Server'
}
